description:
crate-jmap-server/README.md does not mention:
- pub use jmap_types::* re-export block (means consumers can pull JmapError etc. from jmap-server alone)
- backend module re-exports (JmapBackend, BackendSetError, SetError)
- helpers module re-exports (extract_account_id, now_utc_string, ser, not_found_json)

These are intentionally re-exported for ergonomic reasons and form a meaningful slice of the user-facing API. README should at least list them.

Lower priority because the rustdoc on docs.rs makes them visible — README is a duplicate channel.

This is also a LOCKED crate per AGENTS.md (jmap-server is on the locked list — wait, double-check: AGENTS.md lists jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-chat-types, jmap-base-client, jmap-mail-server. jmap-server is NOT locked.) Re-confirm before edit.
title: P3: jmap-server README 'How it works' section understates exported surface
